cats.d: Goals: how often he scores, how good his chances are, and whether he finishes them
Setting up goals, led by primary assists (the last pass)
Chances his team creates at even strength with him on the ice
Chances his team allows at even strength with him on the ice
Hits, blocked shots, and winning the puck back vs giving it away
All-in: how much better his team's chances are with him, adjusted for linemates and opponents

g60.d: Goals per 60 minutes on the ice, all situations.
g60.x: Goals ÷ time on ice × 60 (NHL time on ice).

ixg60.d: Expected goals from his own unblocked shots per 60 minutes: how many and how dangerous his chances are.
ixg60.x: Sum of our xG on his unblocked shots (no empty-net shots) ÷ time on ice × 60.

gax.d: Goals scored minus expected goals from his shots, pulled toward zero when he has few shots. Positive = he finishes better than his chances.
gax.x: (non-empty-net goals − ixG) × n ÷ (n + 150), n = his unblocked shots. Raw number in the note.

shdist.d: Average distance of his unblocked shots, in feet. A style number: low = he shoots from in close.
shdist.x: Mean distance from the net of his unblocked shots (NHL play-by-play coordinates).

a160.d: Primary assists (the last pass before a goal) per 60 minutes, all situations.
a160.x: Primary assists (first assist on NHL goal events) ÷ time on ice × 60.

a15.d: Primary assists per 60 minutes at 5-on-5 only, so power-play time doesn't inflate it.
a15.x: 5v5 primary assists ÷ 5v5 time on ice (from NHL shift charts) × 60.

a60.d: All assists per 60 minutes, all situations.

p60.d: Points per 60 minutes. Shown, not graded (goals already count in Scoring).

rapm_o.d: Expected goals per 60 his team adds at 5v5 with him on the ice, after adjusting for every teammate and opponent, home ice, score and zone starts.
rapm_o.x: Ridge regression (RAPM) on every 5v5 shift of 2024-25 and 2025-26 pooled (one offense term per skater across both seasons): target = team xG per 60. Penalty chosen by how well 2024-25 predicts 2025-26. Same value in both season views; the season-alone fit is in the note.

rxgf.d: His team's 5v5 expected goals per 60 with him on the ice minus with him on the bench.

xgf60.d: His team's 5v5 expected goals per 60 minutes with him on the ice.

rcf.d: Shot attempts (incl. blocked and missed) per 60 with him on the ice minus with him off, 5v5.

rapm_d.d: Expected goals per 60 he takes away from opponents at 5v5, adjusted for teammates, opponents, home ice, score and zone starts. Positive = fewer chances against.
rapm_d.x: Same pooled two-season ridge regression as offense; this is minus his defense term (target = opponent xG per 60).

rxga.d: Opponents' 5v5 expected goals per 60 with him on the ice minus with him off. Lower is better.

xga60.d: Opponents' 5v5 expected goals per 60 with him on the ice. Lower is better.

rca.d: Opponent shot attempts per 60 with him on minus off, 5v5. Lower is better.

blk60.d: Opponent shots he blocks per 60 minutes.
blk60.x: NHL blocked shots ÷ time on ice × 60.

tk60.d: Times he steals the puck per 60 minutes. Recorded by arena scorers, so it varies by rink.

tkgv.d: Takeaways minus giveaways per 60. Players who carry the puck a lot give it away more, so read this as rough.

fo.d: Share of faceoffs won (200+ faceoffs). Shown, not graded.

rapm.d: Offensive impact plus defensive impact: net expected goals per 60 his team gains at 5v5 with him on the ice, lineup-adjusted.
rapm.x: Offense RAPM − defense RAPM (5v5 xG per 60), 2024-25 + 2025-26 pooled. The season-alone fit is in the note.

xgfp.d: Share of all 5v5 expected goals (both teams) that went his team's way with him on the ice.

rxgfp.d: His on-ice xGF% minus his team's xGF% without him.
rxgfp.x: On-ice xGF% − off-ice xGF% (5v5), percentage points.

gfp.d: Share of 5v5 goals his team scored with him on the ice. Shown, not graded: goals swing with luck.

pm.d: Even-strength and shorthanded goals for minus against while he was on the ice. Shown, not graded.

def: Hits per 60 in the top 10% of his position.
Blocked shots per 60 in the top 10% of his position.
Forward who shoots from closer in than 85% of forwards (60+ unblocked shots).
Takeaways per 60 in the top 10% of his position.
Shots per 60 in the top 10% of his position.

meta.score: Category score = weighted average of the graded metrics' percentiles in that category, re-ranked 0-99 against every qualified skater (or every skater in his position group when 'vs position' is on). Style numbers (weight 0) are shown but not graded.
meta.src: NHL public game data (play-by-play, shift charts, season reports). Expected goals, RAPM, percentiles, roles and scores by Spreadsheet Sports.

box.d: The traditional box score, per game played
